strategy_lineage: gnr5-gold-nasdaq-single-day-shock-five-day-reversal-v1; new ATM-COST-2026-08-28-BPS25 lineage with fixed App-cost product stress replay
hypothesis: An extreme one-day CNY gold-minus-Nasdaq return spread tends to reverse over the next five common real observation days, so temporarily holding the laggard can improve a naturally drifting 50/50 gold-Nasdaq portfolio while keeping product-level drawdown at or below 10% without leverage.
allowed_changes: formal BPS25 primary replay and mechanically paired App 1.00% fee + 0.05% slippage product-acceptance stress replay over the identical target path
mechanical reporting of frozen windows and comparison to gold-nasdaq-dual-trend-barbell
selection_metric: No selection or optimization. One exact candidate is evaluated once; product acceptance is determined only by the frozen App-cost stress replay and mechanical gates.
pass_fail_gates: App-cost full-history, last-10-years, 2020+, 2022+, GFC 2008-09-01..2009-06-30, COVID 2020-02-19..2020-04-30 and 2022 tightening window MDD each <=15%
formal BPS25 and App-cost target fingerprints exactly equal
max requested and marked-to-market actual gross <=100%, target weights/holding units/cash nonnegative, no shorting, financing or leverage
strict T-1 and common-real-observation contract tests pass under atm-swift-clock-v3-2026-08-31
follow_up_policy: If any mechanical product gate fails, record REJECTED and stop. No threshold, 60-day window, five-day hold, asset, event, baseline, cost substitution, delay, persistence or rescue variant is allowed after viewing results. Any genuinely different mechanism requires a new lineage and preregistration; GNR-5 itself remains closed.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_gnr5_reversal_formal.py -> tools/gnr5_reversal_formal.swiftpart + AssetTimeMachine/Backtest/GNR5ReversalStrategy.swift -> BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace -> shared BacktestDailySimulator; baseline uses BacktestEngine goldNasdaqDualTrendBarbell mode
expected_outputs: formal BPS25 full history, last 10 years, 2020+, 2022+ and three frozen stress-period metrics
fixed App 1.00% fee + 0.05% slippage replay over the identical target fingerprint with the same windows
current gold-nasdaq-dual-trend-barbell App-cost baseline metrics over the same windows
target/trade fingerprints, target paths, portfolio paths, fill and event counts
target and actual gross, minimum target weight, holding units and cash constraints
mechanical product gate checks and PASS or REJECTED decision
run authorization receipt, execution record, stdout/stderr and SHA-256 artifact manifest

candidate_definition.signal_observations: intersection of dates where gold_cny and nasdaq each have a real observation; forward-filled values never form returns, signal observations or holding-day counts
candidate_definition.standardization: z_t uses sample mean and sample standard deviation of exactly the previous 60 common-observation spread returns, excluding d_t
candidate_definition.positive_trigger: z_t >= 2.0; at the next common executable opportunity target 100% nasdaq
candidate_definition.negative_trigger: z_t <= -2.0; at the next common executable opportunity target 100% gold_cny
candidate_definition.holding_rule: hold the event target through exactly five subsequent common real observation days after the signal; schedule return to baseline after the fifth day so execution occurs at the next common executable opportunity
candidate_definition.overlap_rule: ignore all new signals while an event is active, including the fifth holding observation
candidate_definition.baseline: establish 50/50 gold_cny/nasdaq once; allow natural drift; trade only at initial establishment, event entry and event exit
candidate_definition.causality: strict T-1 signal and target decision, T or later common-real execution through BacktestDailySimulator
candidate_definition.execution: sell before buy; no rebalance band; no leverage, financing or shorting; cash uses CashYieldCNY

cost_models.modeling_rule: One formal family and one formal command: BPS25 is the new-lineage primary result; the App-cost run is a fixed preregistered stress replay, not a second candidate or cost grid. Low-cost performance may never substitute for the product-stress conclusion.

evaluation_windows.full_history: all available App fixture history after engine warmup
evaluation_windows.last_10_years: latest portfolio date minus exactly 10 calendar years through latest

comparison.rule: report same-window metrics; comparison is descriptive and cannot rescue a failed mechanical product gate

forbidden_changes: parameter grid or any threshold other than absolute z=2.0
lookback other than exactly 60 prior common spread returns
holding period other than exactly five subsequent common observations
population standard deviation or inclusion of current return in the standardization window
signals from forward-filled or non-common observations
periodic baseline rebalancing rather than natural drift
assets other than gold_cny and nasdaq or any BTC/fund/external proxy sleeve
leverage, borrowing, margin, shorting, negative cash or gross above 100%
using BPS25 results as the product conclusion
post-result rescue, alternative stress periods or candidate replacement
